model_card.what: character-level next-character model, trained on a lab group chat export
model_card.vocab: the string in "vocab": token i is vocab[i]
model_card.context: the previous 8 characters; left-pad with "\n" (the chat export starts each message on a new line)
model_card.forward: x = concat(emb[c] for c in context)  (8*16 = 128 floats); h = tanh(x @ W1 + b1); logits = h @ W2 + b2
